s.p.espaces.rg_d: Imithetho yokuziphatha, imibandela yemikhiqizo, ukuqashwa kwebhizinisi, ama-platforms wokutshala imali: amacebo asemthethweni ezwe ngalinye.
s.p.espaces.rg_sub: Imithetho ishintsha njalo: ONE WORLD ayikhophi, ivula ama-up-to-date official sources, bese uyifunda ngesiNgisi sakho.
s.p.espaces.rg_g1: I-Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): ngemikhiqizo nezwe, amadokhumenti, izimali, izinqubomgomo kanye nezimiso kwikhasi elinye
s.p.espaces.rg_g2: I-Market Access Map (ITC): amadokhumenti wezokuthutha kanye nemithetho yokuqala
s.p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): ama-standards, ukuphawula kanye nemithetho yezempilo le lizwe liyibeka ngemikhiqizo
s.p.espaces.rg_e2: I-TARIC: ikhodi yezokuthutha kanye nezindleko uma ufika e-EU
s.p.espaces.rg_b1: Ibhizinisi lilungele (i-World Bank): ukuqashwa kwebhizinisi, amaholo, ukuthengiswa kwamazwe omhlaba, izwe ngalinye
s.p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): hlola ukuthi iphrojekthi ayikho ephawulwe ngumthethosivivinywa ngaphambi kokuthembela kuyo ngemali
s.p.espaces.rg_note: Isayithi livula ngesilimi sayo: sebenzisa ukuhumusha kwesikhangeli sakho, noma «Funda idokhumende» ledokhumende. Uma ufuna isixazululo esibaluleke kakhulu,buza ummeli kulezwe.
s.p.espaces.cu_d: Imisebenzi, amadokhumende, i-Incoterms, amathuluzi asemthethweni amahhala, abathumeli kanye nabathumeli.
s.p.espaces.cu_sub: I-guide to buying and selling between countries. 24/24 ONE WORLD ayifaki izibopho zezokuthutha: umhlinzeki wezokuthutha onelayisense (umthumeli wempahla) angakwenza lokhu kuwe.
s.p.espaces.cu_t1: I-Market Access Map (ITC, UN-WTO): imisebenzi nemithetho yezwe ngalinye
s.p.espaces.cu_t2: I-Access2Markets (i-European Union): amadokhumenti, izimali, izinqubomgomo zokuqala, isikhashana ngasinye
s.p.espaces.cu_t3: I-TARIC: ikhodi yezokuthutha (ikhodi le-HS) kanye nezindleko lapho kungena e-European Union
s.p.espaces.cu_d3: Idokhumende lokuthwala: i-bill of lading (sea), i-air waybill (air), CMR (road)
s.p.espaces.cu_d5: Inombolo ye-EORI (izinkampani ezingenisa noma ezikhiqiza e-EU)
s.p.espaces.cu_d6: Ngokuya ngemikhiqizo: isitifiketi sezempilo noma sokudla, ilayisense, imibandela ye-CE
s.p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: umthengi uphatha konke kusuka efektri yomdayisi.
s.p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: umhlinzeki unikeza izinto ezithunyelwa ngaphandle eziqinisekisiwe kumthumeli womthengisi.
s.p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: umhlinzeki ufaka impahla enqanaweni; ngemuva kwalokho, izingozi nezindleko yizo zomthengi.
s.p.espaces.cu_i4: I-CIF: umhlinzeki ukhokhela izindleko zokuthutha kanye ne-inshurensi epulazini lokufinyelela.
s.p.espaces.cu_i5: I-DAP: umhlinzeki uthumela endaweni yokufinyelela, umthengisi ukhokha izindleko zokungeniswa.
s.p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: umhlinzeki ukhokha konke, kufaka phakathi izindleko zokungenisa.
s.p.espaces.cu_ban: Kuvunyelwe noma kulawulwa kuwo wonke amaphuzu: izimpumputhe, amaphilisi, izidakamizwa ezingekho emthethweni, izinhlobo ezikhuselwe (CITES), ezinye izidakamizwa. Uhlu olunjalo aluvumelekile futhi lungashicilelwa (ar).
s.p.espaces.cu_src: Amasu: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, iKomidi lase-Europe, douane.gouv.fr. Qaphela njalo izimiso ezifanele zemikhiqizo yakho.
s.p.espaces.b_kind_mission: Umsebenzi noma i-gig engaphandle (ukunikela noma ukubheka)
s.p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly... uqhathanisa izindleko zezwe lakho ngaphambi kokuthumela.
s.p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD ayithumeli imali ngokwayo futhi ayitholanga lutho kusuka kulezi zixhumanisi: uqhathanisa lapha, bese uthumela ngenkonzo oyikhethayo.
s.p.espaces.mt_wb: Izindleko Zokudluliselwa Kwemali Ezweni Lonke (Ibhange Lezwe): izindleko ezingokoqobo zokuthunyelwa kwemali, izwe ngalinye, inkonzo ngayinye
s.p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Imali ekhokhwayo ezindaweni eziningi kakhulu, ukudluliswa kwebhange, ikhadi lesikweletu leselula
s.p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Ukuthatha imali, ukudluliswa kwebhange, ikhadi lesikweletu leselula
s.p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Ukudluliswa kwebhange ngentengo yokushintshaniswa kwemakethe, amaholo abonisa ngaphambi kokuthumela
s.p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Ukudluliswa kwebhange, ikhadi lesikweletu leselula, ukuqoqwa kwemali
s.p.espaces.mt_p_wr: I-wallet yeselula, ukudluliswa kwebhange, ukuthatha imali
s.p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Thumela ku-wallet yeselula noma kwi-akhawunti yebhange
s.p.espaces.mt_k1: Thola inani eliphelele elifunyenwe: amaholo + isilinganiso sokuguqulwa. Isilinganiso esibi kunalokho kwentengo yemakethe yimali efihlakele.
s.p.espaces.mt_k2: Khetha indlela umuntu othola ngayo: imali engenayo, i-akhawunti yebhanki noma i-wallet yeselula (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN…).
s.p.espaces.mt_k3: Idokhumende le-ID lidingake njalo, ukuthunyelwa kanye nokuqoqwa.
s.p.espaces.mt_k4: Ungathumeli imali kumuntu ohlangana naye kuphela kwi-inthanethi, noma uku "vula" isipho, isitoko, inkokhelo noma i-visa: cishe njalo kuyingozi.
s.p.espaces.mt_note: Izinsizakalo kanye nentengo zishintsha: hlola njalo kuwebhusayithi yabo lapho uthumela khona.
s.p.espaces.ds_d: Thenga ngaphandle kwe-stock: thola umhlinzeki, sebenzela intengo yangempela, uhlale ngaphakathi komthetho.
s.p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping kusho ukuthengisa imikhiqizo ukuthi umhlinzeki izindiza ngqo kumthengisi wakho. Elula ukuqala, kodwa uhlala ehola ukuthengisa.
s.p.espaces.ds_s1: Khetha impahla evunyelwe ezweni lamaklayenti akho: ayikho i-counterfeit, akukho mkhiqizo olawulwayo ngaphandle kwegunya.
s.p.espaces.ds_s2: Thola umhlinzeki ("Wholesale / umhlinzeki" izikhangiso lapha noma wholesale platforms) futhi ucele isampula ngaphambi kokuba uthengise.
s.p.espaces.ds_s3: Umsebenzi ngaphandle intengo engokoqobo: impahla, ukuthunyelwa, izibopho zomthetho, VAT yezwe lomthengi, amazindleko zokukhokha kanye nokubuyiselwa.
s.p.espaces.ds_s4: Batshela abathengisi bakho isikhathi sokulethwa sangempela.
s.p.espaces.ds_s5: Bhala imisebenzi yakho: isimo sebhizinisi, i-VAT kanye namathoyizi ngokuya ngezwe lakho (bona imigomo yebhizinisi).
s.p.espaces.ds_w1: Umhlinzeki ofuna ukukhokha okugcwele ngokuthumela kwebhange okungakhuselwanga noma nge-cryptocurrency.
s.p.espaces.ds_w2: Izifundo ezikhokhelwa ezithembisa ukukwenza ube nomnotho ngokushesha.
s.p.espaces.ds_w3: Izithombe ezilahlekile kanye nezingxoxo zobugebengu: zivunyelwe futhi zigwetshwe.
s.p.espaces.ds_w4: Ku-European Union, iphakethe elivela ngaphandle kwe-EU likhokha i-VAT kusukela ku-euro yokuqala.
s.p.espaces.ds_plat: Izinhlelo zokuhweba ngentengo ephansi (ezincane, azixhunyiwe ku-24/24 ONE WORLD)
s.p.espaces.bo_d: Ama-indices, ama-stocks, ama-currency, ama-commodities nama-cryptocurrencies asuka emhlabeni wonke, nge-charts.
s.p.espaces.bo_sub: Amantengo ahlinzekwa mahhala yi-TradingView, ngamanye amaxesha ngexesha elifutshane lokulibaziseka ngokuya ngotshintshiselwano lwesitokhwe.
s.p.espaces.bo_priv: Xa ucindezela leli qhosha, amantengo afakwa kusuka ku TradingView (inkonzo yangaphandle), endaweni ehlukanisiwe engafinyeleleki kwi-akhawunti yakho.

s.p.espaces.bo_risk: Ukutshala imali kungakulahlisa imali. 24/24 ONE WORLD ayibekezi izicelo, ayigcinanga imali futhi ayinikezanga insizakalo yokutshala imali. Uthenga noma uthengisa, sebenzisa ummeli ogunyaziwe ezweni lakho.

s.p.espaces.sos_sub: Uma kwenzeka ingozi, thinta izinsizakalo zengozi kuqala. Lawa manani asebenza ngaphandle kweso sonke isisebenzisi.
s.p.espaces.sos_women: Ukuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besifazane (ukulalela, mahhala, ngaphandle kwegama)

s.p.espaces.sos_med_sub: Ukuhunyushwa kuphela: lokhu akuyona incazelo yodokotela.
s.p.espaces.sos_offline: Uma kungaxhunyiwe, amagama angaguqulwa: bonisa inani elingezansi.
s.p.papier.title: 📄 Funda idokhumende
s.p.papier.sub: Thola isithombe sombhalo, umyalo, fomu noma isibonakaliso: Funda ngalolu limi lwakho.
s.p.papier.private: Isithombe sihlala kwifoni yakho. Umbhalo kuphela ofundekayo uthunyelwe ku-free translation service.
s.p.papier.first: Isikhathi sokuqala kulolu limi: ifoni ilanda ulwazi lokufundwa kwayo (ama-MB ambalwa).
s.p.papier.none: Akukho mbhalo otholakele. Thola isithombe futhi, sihle futhi sikhanya kakhulu.
s.p.papier.e_lib: Ukufundwa akukwazi ukuqala: isikhathi sokuqala sidinga i-Internet. Zama futhi uma uxhunyiwe.
s.p.papier.e_tr: Ukuhumusha akukwazanga ukukwenziwa (ukuxhumana noma umkhawulo wosuku). Zama futhi.
s.p.papier.warn: Ukuhumusha kwe-machine: uma udinga idokhumende elibalulekile (inkantolo, impilo, imali, imvume yokuhlala), qiniseka ukuthi lihlolwe ngumuntu othembeke kuye noma yinhlangano. Ukubhala ngesandla kuvame ukufundwa ngokungalungile.
